description: EasyLocal 3 (easylocal-legacy v3.4.0) versus EasyLocal 4 on the EasyLocal example problems. Changing this file changes the matrix key: EasyLocal 4 results of different keys are not compared, and the EasyLocal 3 baseline is measured again.

problems.tsp: tour length; 2-opt moves; delta modes: all = the O(1) 2-opt delta (the example's configuration), none = no delta; no mixed mode, as there is a single component
problems.assignment: 1000 * total overload + load imbalance; job reassignment moves; delta modes: all = O(jobs) overload and load-imbalance deltas, mixed = the overload delta only, none = no delta (the example's configuration)
problems.exam: 1000 * student conflicts + 10 * consecutive exams + timeslot load; exam moves; delta modes: all = conflict, consecutive-exam and O(exams) timeslot-load deltas, mixed = no timeslot-load delta (the example's configuration), none = no delta

sd.description: steepest descent (EL3 SteepestDescent, EL4 BestImprovement), until a local optimum

fd.description: first descent (EL3 FirstDescent, scan from a random move; EL4 FirstImprovement, scan from the first move), until a local optimum

sa.description: simulated annealing with a geometric schedule (EL3 SimulatedAnnealing, EL4 SimulatedAnnealing<Classic>)
